View cheaper travel options  More ways of saving money Explore your options for free tram travel, off-peak fares, discoun Cheaper travel before 7am - Early bird Your metropolitan train journey is free if you tap on and off before 7.15am on weekdays. You get the free early bird fare when you: travel on a metropolitan train, or a V/Line service between Pakenham or Sunbury and Melbourne keep a positive account balance tap on and off within 2 hours, before 7.15am on a weekday. To make sure you get the early bird fare, use train services that arrive at your destination by 7am. Cheaper travel after 6pm If you tap on after 6pm, you can travel until 3am the next day. This gives you up to 9 hours of travel for the price of 2 hours.  
